item.description: Archaeologists discovered an 11,000-year-old sculpture in southeastern Turkiye. This unique artwork depicts a human figure seated upon a leopard's back. It adds to growing evidence of advanced capabilities in ancient settled communities. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
